import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time

root = Path.cwd()
base = Path(__file__).parent
original = base / 'general-nested-native-producer-first-0337'
out = base / 'checks/general-native-interior-meaning-controls'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
import native_harness

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

artifact = json.loads((original / 'second-artifact.json').read_bytes())
source = artifact['sources'][0]['text']
assert source.encode() == (original / 'first-source.qli').read_bytes()
cases = [
    ('positive', None, None),
    ('wrong-inner-meaning', 'meaning Inner:Bit=reference(sign);', 'meaning Inner:Bit=reference(keep);'),
    ('wrong-outer-meaning', 'meaning Outer:Bit=reference(keep);', 'meaning Outer:Bit=reference(sign);'),
    ('swapped-original-slots', 'relay[checked_op(sign,Inner),sign]', 'relay[sign,checked_op(sign,Inner)]'),
    ('changed-sibling-provider', 'relay[checked_op(sign,Inner),sign]', 'relay[checked_op(sign,Inner),keep]'),
]
inputs = []
for name, old, new in cases:
    folder = out / name
    folder.mkdir()
    current = json.loads(json.dumps(artifact))
    if old is not None:
        assert source.count(old) == 1
        current['sources'][0]['text'] = source.replace(old, new)
    (folder / 'source.qli').write_text(current['sources'][0]['text'])
    (folder / 'artifact.json').write_text(json.dumps(current, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n')
    shutil.copyfile(original / 'second-request.json', folder / 'request.json')
    inputs.append((name, folder))
driver = out / 'original-driver.lean'
shutil.copyfile(original / 'user-exception-staged-native-driver.lean', driver)
(out / 'before.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'scope': 'Actual unchanged checker; general-composition preparation-only work exception. Whole body, original Meaning bindings and exact I4 oracle remain checked. No handle or bounded production success claimed.',
    'original_source_sha256': sha(original / 'first-source.qli'),
    'positive': 'Both original credits [15,27] and no residual; exact full-phase I4.',
    'negative': 'Old IR/request cannot justify changed original Meaning declarations, ordered actuals or sibling providers.',
    'inputs': {str(p.relative_to(out)): sha(p) for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},
}, indent=2) + '\n')

def snapshot():
    paths = [p for directory in ('lean-kernel', 'src', 'scripts') for p in (root / directory).rglob('*')
             if p.is_file() and '.lake' not in p.parts and p.suffix in ('.lean', '.rs', '.py')]
    paths += [driver] + [p for _, folder in inputs for p in folder.iterdir()]
    return {str(p): sha(p) for p in paths}

before = snapshot()
(out / 'sources-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(before, indent=2) + '\n')
start = time.monotonic()
os.environ['LEAN_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
log = []
results = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='qleisli-general-meaning-controls-') as temporary:
    project = Path(temporary)
    shutil.copyfile(driver, project / 'Main.lean')
    binary = native_harness.build(project, log)
    binary_hash = sha(binary)
    for name, folder in inputs:
        output = native_harness.run([str(binary), str(folder / 'artifact.json'), str(folder / 'request.json')], root, log)
        (out / (name + '.stdout.txt')).write_text(output)
        (out / (name + '.stderr.txt')).write_text(log[-1]['stderr'])
        if name == 'positive':
            passed = 'oracle=Except.ok (); consumed=[15, 27]; residual=[];' in output
        elif name in ('wrong-inner-meaning', 'wrong-outer-meaning'):
            passed = 'EXCEPTION actual body:' in output and 'equation' in output
        else:
            passed = ('EXCEPTION actual body:' in output or 'EXCEPTION actual preparation:' in output) and 'residual=[]' not in output
        results.append(dict(case=name, passed=passed, output=output.strip()))

report = dict(results=results, source_window_unchanged=before == snapshot(),
              seconds=time.monotonic() - start, native_driver_sha256=binary_hash,
              library_sha256=sha(native_harness.LIBRARY),
              child_max_rss_bytes_macos=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss)
(out / 'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(log, indent=2) + '\n')
(out / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if report['source_window_unchanged'] and all(r['passed'] for r in results) else 1)
